title: Map every fact to the curriculum
statement: Map every fact taken from a source to the part of the curriculum it serves, and drop or review the ones that fit none.
example: In one unit's build, 437 of 1,194 facts extracted from source texts mapped to no part of the curriculum.
detail: One unit's knowledge build had a model generate facts from source texts and then map each one to the curriculum (`icloud-work/k_12_social_studies/ap_files/Knowledge Schema Generator - AP USH Unit 1 - Instructions.csv`, line 16). In its mapping output, 437 of 1,194 facts carried 'None' in the cluster column, against 757 mapped to a topic, and the refinement step set facts on whole civilisations aside as out of scope (`icloud-work/k_12_social_studies/ap_files/Knowledge Schema Generator - AP USH Unit 1.xlsx`, sheets '2. Mapping Output' and '6. Fact Refinement Output').
against: An unmapped fact may still be background students need: the reviews kept asking for added definitions and context, so dropping every one could remove support students need (see the record on background at the line that needs it).
